rationale: Separately versioned support extension introduced after the original 20 assigned groups yielded 17 nonempty groups and required fallback.
combination_rule: Pool all original nonempty group-max scores and all extension nonempty group-max scores, each group once; same fixed N1 methods, target definitions and score rule; no selection by score, width or deployment rate.
execution_rule: Attempt all 20 predefined groups; preserve blocked groups and failures; no early stopping at support threshold, replacement seeds or outcome-driven admission changes.
original_result_policy: Preserve original N2 and N3 artifacts unchanged; new combined calibration must have a new version.
exchangeability_note: Fresh RNG streams on shared fixed source rows do not establish exchangeability or independent population samples; nominal coverage remains assumption-dependent.
